title: Close the beta free Crew toggle on the billing switch alone

source.ref: deepest site audit 2026-11-19 (external read-only audit, verified)

detail: toggleMembership (the beta free/Crew self-serve toggle, a public server action) closed only when billingLive() was true, and billingLive() = Stripe env keys AND the billing_live switch. With the switch on but a Stripe key missing or rotated out, the toggle reopened and any member could make themselves Crew for free, which also moves them onto the Crew take-rate rung. Owner ruling 2026-11-19 16:01Z on the decision card: "Shut on the switch alone". Fix: the toggle refuses when billingLiveFlag() OR billingLive() is true. Prod today: billing_live is on and the keys are set, so it was already shut; this keeps it shut if a key goes missing.

verify.note: Fails on main: the toggle gates on billingLive() only. Passes when billingLiveFlag() alone closes it before the tier write.
